prompt:
You are a hardware-debug reviewer. A first debug agent diagnosed an RISC-V RTL failure and an explain.png diagram was drawn from that diagnosis (explain.png sha256 first 16 hex: cbd29d1a25ab49ae).
Case: rdata-latch
Failing trace window (same window the first diagnosis saw):
- tb_picorv32_fetch seed 43
- 256-word NOP mem, checking fetch alignment + trap + progress
tohost: FAIL 0xdead
TRAP: cpu trap asserted
CYCLES=2009
- /home/tuncay/afterglow/sim/tb/picorv32-fetch_tb.sv:91: Verilog $finish
- S i m u l a t i o n   R e p o r t: Verilator 5.052 2026-09-05
- Verilator: $finish at 20us; walltime 0.001 s; speed 38.577 ms/s
- Verilator: cpu 0.001 s on 1 threads; allocated 4 MB
First diagnosis (verbatim):
NOP fetch traps with `TRAP: cpu trap asserted` and `FAIL 0xdead` instead of progressing. picosoc/picosoc.v:127 and picosoc/picosoc.v:130 show mem_ready/mem_rdata combinationally valid during mem_xfer, so fresh mem_rdata is expected. picorv32.v:384 selects mem_rdata_q when (mem_xfer || LATCHED_MEM_RDATA) and mem_rdata otherwise, using stale data on the transfer cycle and decoding garbage to trap.
First patch_diff:
diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -384,1 +384,1 @@
-	assign mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle = (mem_xfer || LATCHED_MEM_RDATA) ? mem_rdata_q : mem_rdata;
+	assign mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle = (mem_xfer || LATCHED_MEM_RDATA) ? mem_rdata : mem_rdata_q;
Look at the diagram (explain.png in the run bundle) together with the trace above. Either CONFIRM the first diagnosis (it explains the failing signal and the diff fixes it) or REVISE it (it misnames the signal or the diff is wrong). Reply JSON ONLY with keys: decision (exactly "CONFIRM" or "REVISE"), diagnosis (final diagnosis text), patch_diff (final unified diff), reason (one sentence: why the diagram confirms or what it corrects).
